independent_verifier_defect.name: previously-authoritative quorum has no remembered global maximum
independent_verifier_defect.reproduction: Epoch 2 reached 2-of-3 authority on A+B while C lagged at epoch 1. Restoring only local current state and B to epoch 1 left A intact at epochs [1,2], yet Wave 101 counted stale B plus lagging C and accepted epoch 1 again.

repair.rule: The global maximum advances only after the exact current local authority is observed on the registered 2-of-3 remote quorum and an explicit predecessor-linked certificate is appended.
repair.important_distinction: A newer record observed on only one witness is not global finality. A newer authority that actually reached quorum and was certified cannot later be forgotten by two stale/lagging matching heads.

initial_ci.cause: The first crafted sibling changed authority_sha, so support-binding verification rejected it before the intended duplicate-sequence store check.

synthetic_scaling.label: SYNTHETIC single-process quorum-certificate/remote-history bookkeeping only; runs occurred on separate GitHub-hosted runners and are not a normal-vs-optimized performance comparison. Not OS-process/provider/network/energy/AXM-monolith/retained/incremental/dormant-compute evidence.

counterexamples_preserved: The three remote witnesses and quorum-certificate store are still modeled Python state inside one process.
Rolling local runtime, the certificate store, and enough modeled remote stores back together can still recreate an internally valid old world.

The certificate store is not independently authenticated: content hashes detect retained-body mutation and broken lineage, but malicious replacement of the whole modeled store is not independently detectable in this wave.
Certificate support records are content-addressed integrity evidence, not independent public-key remote attestations; remote credentials remain symmetric test tokens.
Two compromised current remote credentials can still participate in the modeled 2-of-3 acceptance surface or poison availability; this is not a production Byzantine-consensus claim.
A newer record visible on only one witness is intentionally not promoted to global finality.
Mechanical quorum chronology does not prove moral/root judgment correctness, consent, evaluator legitimacy, or canonical AXM authority.
truth_boundary: No fresh AXM/monolith workload was used because the newest independent verifier exposed a protocol rollback defect that had to be repaired before stronger deployment claims.
No merge or CANON promotion was performed.
No physical/provider independence, network, energy, retained-compute, incremental-compute, or dormant-compute win is claimed.
next_gate: Wave 103: move the quorum-certified maximum plus repaired registry/authority chronology across at least three real OS processes with separate durable stores and separately held credentials. Test kill/restart, stale durable-store restoration, partition/reconnect, partial publication before versus after quorum certification, certificate-store rollback, credential rotation, one-process quarantine, two-process compromise, and recovery with one certificate witness unavailable. Treat success as process-level evidence only, not physical/provider independence.
